title: Hygiene pricing question stays in the knowledge-base branch
description: The caller asks only about the hygiene price. The assistant should answer from the knowledge base with the fixed fee and avoid drifting into scheduling or handoff flows.

rubric.description: The assistant should consult the knowledge base for the hygiene price question.
rubric.root_cause_hint: pricing question branch stopped using searchKnowledgeBase

rubric.description: The knowledge base should return a supported answer for hygiene pricing.
rubric.root_cause_hint: hygiene pricing entry or retrieval scoring drifted

rubric.description: The assistant reply should mention the fixed hygiene price.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant surfaced the fixed-price answer incompletely

rubric.description: A pricing question must not trigger scheduling immediately.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant pushed the pricing question into the booking branch

rubric.description: A pricing-only question must not create a booking.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant attempted to createEvent during a pricing question
